content: You and I are all as much continuous with the physical universe as a wave is continuous with the ocean.
author: Alan Watts
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Water is the softest thing on earth, yet it carves through solid granite. It doesn't fight obstacles; it yields, flows around them, and quietly finds its way to its natural level.

Alan Watts understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When we force outcomes with brute willpower and anxiety, we exhaust ourselves and create unnecessary resistance. Aligning with nature means trusting the timing of things and moving with steady, patient persistence.
reflectionPrompt: In what relationship or encounter can you practice seeing beyond outer masks into shared humanity?
